metadata.title: How to Link Unindexed Images to FS by Ann Tanner    10 minutes
metadata.author: BYU Library Family History Center
metadata.shortDescription: This brief video will walk you through the process of linking unindexed images in FamilySearch to the person to whom it belongs.
